exclusion_criteria: infrastructure failure in any arm of a unit
preregistration.pilot_reduction_justification: Original proposal: 4 mechanisms x 1 variant x 2 seeds x 5 arms = 40 runs. E04 is blocked by the Oracle STOP rule. Each real engine run costs 2-3 CLI jobs; to stay within the authorised pilot budget we use 1 seed per remaining independent mechanism x 5 arms = 15 real runs. Seeds are not independent units, so this reduction does not change the unit of inference; it reduces replicate precision only. FULL EXPERIMENT IS NOT AUTHORIZED from this pilot.
preregistration.retry_rules: failed arm retried explicitly with archived evidence; completed arms never silently rerun
preregistration.seed_policy: seed is a repeated measurement, never an independent unit
